sentences.en: One of the missions of 99PI is to give you the tools to decode the built world
sentences.zh: 《99%隐形》的使命之一，就是为你提供解读人造世界的工具，

sentences.en: in cities, in the country, and the highways in between.
sentences.zh: 无论是在城市、乡村，还是连接它们的公路上。

sentences.en: It's those highways and the truckers that drive the American economy
sentences.zh: 正是这些公路，以及驱动美国经济的卡车司机们，

sentences.en: that is the subject of the new Radiotopia show called Over the Road.
sentences.zh: 成为了Radiotopia新节目《公路之上》的主题。

sentences.en: The podcast is a window into a world that you pass by at 65 miles an hour
sentences.zh: 这档播客为你打开了一扇窗，让你得以窥见那个你以每小时65英里的速度飞驰而过，
却从未多加留意的世界。

sentences.en: But it is so fascinating, you will never see a semi-truck the same way again.
sentences.zh: 但它实在太迷人了，看完之后，你再也不会以同样的眼光看待半挂卡车了。
每一位《99%隐形》的“美丽书呆子”都应该订阅。

sentences.en: It is right up your alley.
Here's the first episode of Over the Road, hosted by Long Haul Paul.
sentences.zh: 这是《公路之上》的第一集，由“长途保罗”主持。

sentences.en: Four years ago, I was northbound on I-75 in Knoxville, Tennessee.
sentences.zh: 四年前，我正驾车沿田纳西州诺克斯维尔的75号州际公路北上。

sentences.en: They had sailed on a container ship from Guatemala to South Florida,
sentences.zh: 它们从危地马拉乘集装箱船抵达南佛罗里达，

sentences.en: where they were transferred by forklift onto big trucks driven by folks like me.
sentences.zh: 在那里被叉车装上像我这样的司机驾驶的大卡车。

sentences.en: These were those tiny, seedless, designer types they call personal watermelons.
sentences.zh: 这些就是那种被称为“个人西瓜”的小型无籽精品西瓜。

sentences.en: I always wondered about the marketing cat who came up with that one.
sentences.zh: 我一直很好奇，到底是哪个营销天才想出了这个名字。

sentences.en: It's like a watermelon you can have as a friend.
sentences.zh: 就像是一个你可以当朋友的西瓜。

sentences.en: I was pulling a refrigerated trailer back then.
sentences.zh: 那时我拉的是冷藏拖车。

sentences.en: A reefer, as we call them.
A reefer is a heavily insulated box trailer equipped with a giant diesel-powered temperature control unit.
sentences.zh: 冷藏柜是一个重型隔热箱式拖车，配备了巨大的柴油动力温控装置。

sentences.en: It's actually got the capacity to maintain more than 40,000 pounds of perishable freight
sentences.zh: 它实际上有能力维持超过4万磅易腐货物的温度，

sentences.en: at temperatures as cold as 20 below.
It was rush hour in Knoxville, or K-Town in Trucker Code.
sentences.zh: 当时正值诺克斯维尔的交通高峰期，卡车司机行话叫“K城”。

sentences.en: Traffic came to a screeching halt at the junction of I-75 and I-640.
sentences.zh: 在75号和640号州际公路的交汇处，车流突然刺耳地停了下来。

sentences.en: I got stopped in time, but the trucker behind me?
sentences.zh: 我及时刹住了车，但跟在我后面的卡车司机呢？

sentences.en: I ended up to collect myself, and walked to the back of the trailer to check first on the other driver.
sentences.zh: 我稳了稳情绪，走到拖车后面，先去查看另一位司机的情况。

sentences.en: Then I opened the vent hatch to check my load.
sentences.zh: 然后我打开通风口检查我的货物。

sentences.en: What seconds before had been a perfectly picked personal watermelon was now prolapsing through its ruptured rind,
sentences.zh: 几秒钟前还是个完美采摘的“个人西瓜”，现在却从破裂的瓜皮中涌出，

sentences.en: down the crumpled exterior of what had once been the trailer's stainless steel door,
sentences.zh: 顺着曾经是拖车不锈钢门、如今已撞得皱巴巴的表面流下，

sentences.en: and on to my trembling hand.
Unbeknownst to me at the time, this baptism and the puree of a personal watermelon
sentences.zh: 当时我并不知道，这次洗礼和这滩“个人西瓜”泥，

sentences.en: would come to be my own creative big bang.
sentences.zh: 竟会成为我个人创作生涯的“大爆炸”。

sentences.en: Strangely, as a result of this event, I would come to be a part-time recording artist,
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，这件事让我后来成为了一名业余录音艺术家，

sentences.en: and now even a card-carrying, podcast-producing Radiotopian.
sentences.zh: 现在甚至成了一名持证上岗、制作播客的Radiotopia成员。

sentences.en: You're listening to Over the Road.
sentences.zh: 你正在收听的是《公路之上》。

sentences.en: I got that Lucille, Lucille from Mobile.
sentences.zh: 我得到了那个露西尔，来自莫比尔的露西尔。

sentences.en: Now I'm on the top of this mountain,
and I know I still got to get down the other side somehow.
sentences.zh: 我知道我还得想办法下到另一边去。

sentences.en: And I'm so scared, I'm shaking.
But I know quite a few drivers that swear by roasting salmon over their engine.
sentences.zh: 但我认识不少司机，他们坚信在发动机上烤三文鱼效果绝佳。

sentences.en: We were willing to take a pot-bellied pig.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至愿意载一头大肚猪。

sentences.en: We tried to even pick up a 60-pound tortoise.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至试过搭载一只60磅重的陆龟。

sentences.en: A lot of people say, ah, times are changing.
But why shouldn't it be that way?
sentences.zh: 但为什么不该是那样呢？

sentences.en: Here's how this is going to work.
We've been traveling all over the country,
sentences.zh: 我们一直在全国各地奔波，

sentences.en: down the highways and the hedges,
sentences.zh: 穿梭于公路与乡间小道，

sentences.en: collecting the real stories of real people who live and work over the road.
sentences.zh: 收集那些在公路上生活和工作的真实人们的真实故事。

sentences.en: We've got eight episodes for you.
sentences.zh: 我们为你准备了八集节目。

sentences.en: In each one, we explore how trucking is changing today.
sentences.zh: 每一集，我们都会探讨卡车运输业在当今的变化。

sentences.en: And along the way, I'll tell you a few of my own stories.
sentences.zh: 一路上，我也会讲讲我自己的故事。

sentences.en: Heck, I might even sing you a few songs.
sentences.zh: 见鬼，我甚至可能还会为你唱上几首歌。

sentences.en: Let's start out at a place called the Kentucky Expo Center in Louisville,
sentences.zh: 让我们从路易斯维尔的肯塔基博览中心开始，

sentences.en: home to the Mid-America Trucking Show, or Matt's for short.
sentences.zh: 那里是美国中部卡车展（简称MATS）的举办地。

sentences.en: Think of a Home Depot, about 12 times its normal size,
sentences.zh: 想象一个比普通家得宝大12倍的地方，

sentences.en: then fill it with trucks, truck drivers,
sentences.zh: 然后塞满卡车、卡车司机，

sentences.en: and every possible thing anyone has ever thought of to make a buck off a trucker.
sentences.zh: 以及任何人们能想到的、能从卡车司机身上赚钱的玩意儿。

sentences.en: It's an automatic snow chain system.
sentences.zh: 这是一种自动防滑链系统。

sentences.en: It works good on a buck.
sentences.zh: 它在公鹿身上效果很好。

sentences.en: So what we're selling is bed bug heaters for truckers that have cabs.
sentences.zh: 所以我们卖的是给有驾驶室的卡车司机用的臭虫加热器。

sentences.en: Throw in 90,000 people with some concerts and swag,
sentences.zh: 再加上9万人、几场音乐会和各种赠品。

sentences.en: and you've got the Mid-America Trucking Show.
You've got your air freshener dudes.
sentences.zh: 还有卖空气清新剂的伙计们。

sentences.en: Odor eliminator products for the highway professionals.
sentences.zh: 为公路专业人士提供的除味产品。

sentences.en: We say three sprays last for days.
sentences.zh: 我们说喷三次能管好几天。

sentences.en: Tell me about this beef jerky.
You've got those old boys who make the beef jerky.
sentences.zh: 还有那些做牛肉干的老伙计们。

sentences.en: That's one of the most tender beef jerky you'll ever eat.
sentences.zh: 那是你吃过最嫩的牛肉干之一。

sentences.en: I actually love those guys, too.
Oh, we are an insurance company that specializes in owner-operators.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们是一家专门为自营车主提供服务的保险公司。

sentences.en: They're the international vendors hoping to land that big contract.
sentences.zh: 他们是希望拿下大合同的国际供应商。

sentences.en: Y'all can have a slow bar.
sentences.zh: 你们可以弄个慢速吧台。

sentences.en: Big truck makers are here, like Kenworth and Peterbilt.
sentences.zh: 大型卡车制造商都在这儿，比如肯沃斯和彼得比尔特。

sentences.en: We have our new 579 Ultra Loft, and it's blackout.
sentences.zh: 我们有新款579 Ultra Loft，而且是全黑化版本。

sentences.en: I'm proud to tell people I can't afford a real one, but I can hook you up with a real nice toy one.
sentences.zh: 我很自豪地告诉人们，我买不起真车，但我能给你弄到非常精致的玩具车。

sentences.en: But for many long-time gear jammers, that signifies something more.
sentences.zh: 但对于许多资深卡车司机来说，这有着更深层的意义。

sentences.en: It's a hobo convention of sorts.
sentences.zh: 这算是一种流浪汉大会。

sentences.en: A chance to see old trucking buddies and to swap stories.
sentences.zh: 一个见见老卡车司机朋友、交换故事的机会。
这就是我们来这儿的原因。

sentences.en: If you want to know what's going on in the trucking world, this is a good place to start.
sentences.zh: 如果你想了解卡车界正在发生什么，这里是个很好的起点。

sentences.en: But first, let's cover some basics.
sentences.zh: 但首先，让我们了解一些基本情况。

sentences.en: There are 4.2 million Americans who hold a CDL.
sentences.zh: 有420万美国人持有商业驾照（CDL）。

sentences.en: A CDL allows us to drive a vehicle weighing over 26,000 pounds.
sentences.zh: 商业驾照允许我们驾驶重量超过26000磅的车辆。

sentences.en: Together, we move 70% of all domestic freight.
sentences.zh: 我们共同承担了国内70%的货运量。

sentences.en: Everything you see at the store, everything you buy online, moves by truck at some point.
sentences.zh: 你在商店看到的一切，你在网上买的一切，在某个环节都是由卡车运输的。

sentences.en: Add it all up, we're talking about a $700 billion industry, moving literally 55 billion pounds of stuff every day.
sentences.zh: 加起来，这是一个价值7000亿美元的行业，每天运输的货物重达550亿磅。

sentences.en: At that rate, American truckers could haul off the Great Pyramid of Giza stone by stone about five times a day.
sentences.zh: 照这个速度，美国卡车司机每天大约能把吉萨大金字塔搬走五次。

sentences.en: Of course, there are lots of different types of truckers and trucks out there.
sentences.zh: 当然，外面有很多不同类型的卡车和卡车司机。

sentences.en: Refrigerator freight trucks, they call them reefer trucks.
sentences.zh: 冷藏货运卡车，他们叫它冷藏车。

sentences.en: You know, like what I drive.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像我开的那种。

sentences.en: Flat beds, we should call them skateboards.
sentences.zh: 平板车，我们应该叫它滑板车。

sentences.en: Those big flat trailers with loads of lumber and steel.
sentences.zh: 那些装载木材和钢材的大型平板拖车。

sentences.en: Car haulers, they call them parking lots.
sentences.zh: 汽车运输车，他们叫它停车场。

sentences.en: Bed bugger is a furniture hauler.
sentences.zh: 搬家公司的人被称为“臭虫”。

sentences.en: A tanker truck, we call a tanker yanker.
sentences.zh: 油罐车，我们叫它“油罐拉手”。

sentences.en: I drive one of those sometimes, too.
Trucks that haul bull, they call them bull haulers.
sentences.zh: 运牛的卡车，他们叫它运牛车。

sentences.en: I mean, there's all kinds of terminology for them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，关于它们有各种各样的术语。

sentences.en: As you can imagine, we have our own factions, cliques, and hierarchies.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，我们有自己的派系、小圈子和等级制度。

sentences.en: Flat bedders don't usually associate with their reefer guys like me.
sentences.zh: 开平板车的通常不和我们这些开冷藏车的混在一起。

sentences.en: And the bull haulers could never see themselves as freight haulers.
sentences.zh: 而运牛车的也绝不会把自己看作是普通货运司机。

sentences.en: Or door swingers, as they call them.
sentences.zh: 或者像他们所说的“开门人”。

sentences.en: Because all a door swinger does is back up to the dock and swing the doors open and shut.
sentences.zh: 因为“开门人”所做的全部工作就是倒车到码头，然后开关车门。

sentences.en: But here, for three days at least, none of that matters.
sentences.zh: 但在这里，至少这三天里，这些都不重要。

sentences.en: And not a one of us came here to have a bad time.
sentences.zh: 而且我们中没有一个人是来这里找不痛快的。

sentences.en: Volvo Dynamic Steering with Stability Assist is a new innovation from Volvo Trucks.
sentences.zh: 沃尔沃动态转向系统与稳定性辅助是沃尔沃卡车的一项创新。

sentences.en: A lot of the talk at Matt's this year is about new technology.
sentences.zh: 今年在卡车展上，大家谈论最多的是新技术。

sentences.en: When a truck starts to skid.
It seems every part of the truck has got a computer in it now.
sentences.zh: 现在卡车的每个部件似乎都装了电脑。

sentences.en: The active suspension seat is turned on.
Notice how much of the bouncing is eliminated by the active suspension seat's computer-controlled motor.
sentences.zh: 注意看主动悬挂座椅的电脑控制电机消除了多少颠簸。

sentences.en: And there's a feeling the technology is not just changing the truck.
sentences.zh: 而且人们有一种感觉，技术不仅在改变卡车。

sentences.en: But it's changing us and the way we do business.
sentences.zh: 它也在改变我们和我们的经营方式。

sentences.en: That the codes and culture of trucking are eroding before our eyes.
sentences.zh: 卡车运输的准则和文化正在我们眼前逐渐消逝。

sentences.en: Like I think it last year.
I bump into a Facebook friend on the show floor named Greg Murphy, who now works for Uber.
sentences.zh: 我在展厅碰到了一个Facebook好友，叫格雷格·墨菲，他现在在优步工作。

sentences.en: Threw in a resume and I figured, oh, this is never going to happen.
sentences.zh: 投了份简历，我想，哦，这肯定没戏。
没错，就是那个网约车公司，优步。

sentences.en: Now, Greg, you have a unique story because you are a long-time truck driver.
sentences.zh: 那么，格雷格，你的故事很独特，因为你是一位资深卡车司机。

sentences.en: Who has become like the public relations liaison for Uber.
sentences.zh: 却变成了优步的公关联络人。

sentences.en: Kind of the interpreter, I would call it, between the trucking community and Uber Freight.
sentences.zh: 我称他为卡车运输界和优步货运（Uber Freight）之间的翻译官。

sentences.en: Greg is affable, middle-aged, with a salt-and-pepper beard and a cool fedora.
sentences.zh: 格雷格（Greg）为人随和，人到中年，留着花白的胡子，戴着一顶很酷的软呢帽。

sentences.en: More truck driver than computer person, that's for sure.
sentences.zh: 他更像是个卡车司机，而不是搞电脑的，这一点毋庸置疑。

sentences.en: All around him is a veritable phalanx of Uber's black-shirted millennials.
sentences.zh: 他周围全是优步那些穿着黑衬衫的千禧一代，简直像是一道人墙。
但格雷格说的是一口流利的“卡车司机语”。

sentences.en: And so he pulls out his phone and shows me...
sentences.zh: 于是他掏出手机给我看……

sentences.en: ...another middle-aged guy in yet another fedora.
sentences.zh: ……又是另一个戴着软呢帽的中年男人。

sentences.en: So here it is, it opens up.
...how to use the Uber Freight app.
sentences.zh: ……如何使用优步货运的应用程序。

sentences.en: And it knows that I'm in Louisville today, so now it's thinking about it.
sentences.zh: 它知道我今天在路易斯维尔，所以它正在处理中。

sentences.en: And so it has these little cards for each load, right?
sentences.zh: 它为每一单货运都生成了这样的小卡片，对吧？

sentences.en: So instead of connecting cars with riders, Uber Freight is connecting trucks with loads.
sentences.zh: 所以优步货运不是在连接乘客和车辆，而是在连接卡车和货物。

sentences.en: So read that off to us, Greg, if you would.
sentences.zh: 格雷格，麻烦你给我们读一下。

sentences.en: So this one is from Walton, Kentucky, to Los Alamos, California, for $3,070.
sentences.zh: 这一单是从肯塔基州的沃尔顿到加利福尼亚州的洛斯阿拉莫斯，运费是3070美元。

sentences.en: That's the price for this load.
It has what type of trailer, the load number and all that, what it is, the weight.
sentences.zh: 上面写着拖车类型、货运编号、货物内容以及重量等信息。

sentences.en: All I have to do is tap that card, and the load is mine.
sentences.zh: 我只需要点一下那张卡片，这单货就是我的了。
不用打电话，也不用讨价还价。

sentences.en: Technology is coming, and we need to embrace it and be part of the conversation.
sentences.zh: 技术正在到来，我们需要拥抱它，并参与到这场对话中来。

sentences.en: I have to wonder, though, at $3,000 on a stated distance of 1,800 miles,
sentences.zh: 不过我还是有点疑问，在1800英里的既定距离下，运费3000美元，

sentences.en: doesn't no haggle simply mean take it or leave it?
sentences.zh: “不讨价还价”难道不就意味着“爱干不干”吗？

sentences.en: I'm going to just confess to you, there is a primal fear about the power of a company like this.
sentences.zh: 我不得不向你坦白，人们对这样一家公司的力量有着一种原始的恐惧。

sentences.en: I think change overall is just difficult for people to embrace.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们总体上很难接受变革。

sentences.en: We don't know what it's going to look like, and that creates anxiety.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道未来会是什么样子，这会产生焦虑。

sentences.en: That said, truckers are embracing new technology and using it for their own benefit.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，卡车司机们正在拥抱新技术，并利用它为自己谋利。

sentences.en: You've got quite a hat collection.
Well, way back when, I gave myself heat stroke by being stupid.
sentences.zh: 嗯，很久以前，因为我太蠢，把自己搞中暑了。
以桑德拉·戈希（Sandra Goshi）为例。

sentences.en: Basically, you tell them how the people treated you, if you were professional,
sentences.zh: 基本上，你会告诉他们别人是怎么对待你的，你是否表现得专业，

sentences.en: if there was a bathroom that you could use,
sentences.zh: 是否有你可以使用的洗手间，

sentences.en: because there's a lot of places that don't allow truckers to use their bathroom.
sentences.zh: 因为有很多地方是不允许卡车司机使用他们的洗手间的。

sentences.en: It's a rating app, basically like Yelp for loading docks.
sentences.zh: 这是一款评分应用，基本上就是装卸货码头的“大众点评”。

sentences.en: You kind of help the trucker after you or the person after you.
sentences.zh: 你这样做其实是在帮助你后面的卡车司机或其他人。

sentences.en: They've surveyed over 10,000 truckers about their experiences.
sentences.zh: 他们已经调查了超过1万名卡车司机的体验。

sentences.en: Sandra here is Dock 411's number one reviewer.
sentences.zh: 桑德拉是Dock 411上排名第一的评论员。

sentences.en: If they have forklifts that you use forklifts,
sentences.zh: 如果他们有叉车，你是否使用了叉车，

sentences.en: what are some of the other attributes, Stephen, that you can rethink of?
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬，还有哪些属性是你还能想到的？

sentences.en: If there's overnight parking, if you can sleep there in the overnight parking.
sentences.zh: 是否有过夜停车位，是否可以在那里过夜休息。

sentences.en: Sandra drives as a team with her husband, Stephen.
sentences.zh: 桑德拉和她的丈夫斯蒂芬是搭档开车。

sentences.en: Professionalism, how you were treated professional.
sentences.zh: 专业性，你受到的对待是否专业。

sentences.en: If I was to read the review that I put in for this one dock,
sentences.zh: 如果我要读一下我为这个码头写的评论，

sentences.en: I would never take freight into this dock.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会再接去这个码头的货。

sentences.en: We went in there the first time, and we waited three hours to get unloaded,
sentences.zh: 我们第一次去那里时，等了三个小时才卸完货，

sentences.en: Second time we went in there, we waited 13 hours.
sentences.zh: 第二次去的时候，我们等了13个小时。

sentences.en: No bathrooms, no facilities, and couldn't leave the truck.
sentences.zh: 没有洗手间，没有设施，而且还不让离开卡车。

sentences.en: Reviews like that are added up and turned into a scorecard for every dock they do business with.
sentences.zh: 像这样的评论会被汇总起来，为他们合作的每一个码头生成一份评分表。

sentences.en: Dock 411, it's one of those things that it's like,
it's never going to be complete because there's always going to be new docks.
sentences.zh: 它永远不会有完成的一天，因为总会有新的码头出现。

sentences.en: But it's going to be a big relief to all us truckers.
sentences.zh: 但这对于我们所有卡车司机来说，将是一个巨大的解脱。

sentences.en: But there's still another technology on truckers' minds at Matt's this year.
sentences.zh: 但今年在MATS（美国卡车展），卡车司机们还在关注另一项技术。

sentences.en: Something much more consequential than a new app.
sentences.zh: 这比一个新应用重要得多。

sentences.en: The electronic log situation has become a pretty big issue.
sentences.zh: 电子日志的情况已经变成了一个相当大的问题。

sentences.en: We still didn't need an e-log.
sentences.zh: 我们根本不需要电子日志。

sentences.en: I mean, most of the time...

sentences.zh: 我们以前没有电子日志。

sentences.en: It ain't riding with me no more.
sentences.zh: 它再也不会跟我一起上路了。

sentences.en: This e-log issue is all playing out right now.
sentences.zh: 这个电子日志的问题现在正闹得沸沸扬扬。

sentences.en: And it's pretty much the biggest change that's come to our culture.
sentences.zh: 这几乎是我们行业文化中发生的最大变化。

sentences.en: At least since I started trucking.
sentences.zh: 至少在我开始跑卡车以来是这样。

sentences.en: It ain't riding with me no more.
sentences.zh: 它再也不会跟我一起上路了。

sentences.en: Hundreds of big rigs took over Highway 99 in protest today.
sentences.zh: 今天，数百辆大型卡车占领了99号高速公路进行抗议。

sentences.en: Some truckers have even put on protests about ELDs.
sentences.zh: 一些卡车司机甚至发起了关于ELD的抗议活动。

sentences.en: It's one of those things that just keeps coming up in our conversations with drivers.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在与司机交谈时不断出现的话题之一。

sentences.en: So on our first day at Matt's, we find ourselves at the vintage maroon Peterbilt.
sentences.zh: 在MATS的第一天，我们发现自己站在一辆复古的栗色彼得比尔特（Peterbilt）卡车前。

sentences.en: Of someone who's been at the center of so much of the proteSt.
sentences.zh: 站在这么多抗议活动核心的人。

sentences.en: Yeah, so my name's Mike Landis from Lidditz, Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 是的，我叫迈克·兰迪斯（Mike Landis），来自宾夕法尼亚州的利蒂茨。

sentences.en: A little Amish country town in Lancaster County.
sentences.zh: 兰开斯特县的一个阿米什小镇。

sentences.en: Um, I got into trucking right out of high school pretty much.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我高中一毕业就差不多开始跑卡车了。

sentences.en: I got my CDL after I graduated.
sentences.zh: 我毕业后就拿到了商业驾照（CDL）。

sentences.en: First time I got behind the wheel at the driving school at the local Votek, it was all downhill from there.
sentences.zh: 第一次在当地职业技术学校的驾校坐在驾驶座上时，从此就一发不可收拾了。

sentences.en: E-logs are all about how truckers record their driving and working hours.
sentences.zh: 电子日志是关于卡车司机如何记录他们的驾驶和工作时间的。

sentences.en: So yeah, we have what they call our hours of service, which is, um, once you come on duty, you're allowed 14 hours of working time.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我们有所谓的“服务时间”，就是说，一旦你开始当班，你有14个小时的工作时间。

sentences.en: Um, 11 of that 14 can be driving, but then you have to take 10 hours off before you can go back to work.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这14个小时里有11个小时可以用来开车，但之后你必须休息10个小时才能重新开始工作。

sentences.en: So every day you get 14 hours on duty, and you have to take 10 hours off.
sentences.zh: 所以每天你有14个小时的当班时间，而且必须休息10个小时。

sentences.en: The problem with that is, is that once you start your day, your clock for the day doesn't stop.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，一旦你开始了一天的工作，你的计时器就不会停止。

sentences.en: Now in the past, those hours were recorded in paper log books.
sentences.zh: 过去，这些时间是用纸质日志记录的。

sentences.en: Every driver kept a set of books in the cab, recorded their time with a pen on a four-line grid, and made that log available to inspectors and state patrol.
sentences.zh: 每个司机都在驾驶室里放一套记录本，用笔在四线格上记录时间，并把日志提供给检查员和州巡警查看。
基本上，你是自我监管的。

sentences.en: So to me that's important, because I was taught the old way of trucking.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说这很重要，因为我学的是老派的卡车运输方式。

sentences.en: You know, you do what you gotta do to get the job done, but you sleep when you're tired, and you know, you truck when you're awake.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你做你该做的事来完成工作，但累了就睡，醒着就开车。

sentences.en: If you took a quick nap in your shift, or ran a little over the time limit, you could juggle that.
sentences.zh: 如果你在班次中打了个盹，或者稍微超过了时间限制，你可以灵活调整。

sentences.en: You don't turn into a zombie just because you're five minutes past your time and fall asleep and drive off the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 你不会因为超时了五分钟就变成僵尸，然后睡着并把车开出路外。

sentences.en: That is, you could juggle it, until the electronic logging device.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，在电子记录设备出现之前，你是可以灵活调整的。

sentences.en: And basically what that does is it hooks into the computer on the motor of the truck, and it records everything you do.
sentences.zh: 它基本上是连接到卡车发动机的电脑上，记录你所做的一切。

sentences.en: You know, how hard you're on the throttle, how hard you're on the brake, if you're moving, if you're stopped, your speed, the whole nine yards.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你踩油门有多猛，刹车有多急，是否在移动，是否停下，你的速度，所有的一切。

sentences.en: It counts down every second of your day.
sentences.zh: 它记录你一天中的每一秒。

sentences.en: So, whereas before on a paper log book, if you're five minutes past your time pulling in the truck stop, nobody knew the difference, no harm, no foul.
sentences.zh: 所以，以前用纸质日志时，如果你在开进卡车休息站时超时了五分钟，没人会发现，没造成什么伤害，也没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: But now, I mean, I've seen people backed halfway in a parking spot in truck stops already, because if they finish backing up,
sentences.zh: 但现在，我是说，我已经看到有人在卡车休息站倒车倒了一半就停下了，因为如果他们倒完车，

sentences.en: their ELD is going to put them in violation to go another 50 feet and back the truck up into a parking spot.
sentences.zh: 他们的ELD就会判定他们违规，因为他们多开了50英尺把车倒进停车位。

sentences.en: Yeah, you hear stories like this all the time.
sentences.zh: 是的，你总是能听到这样的故事。

sentences.en: Trucks beached like whales in the most god-awful places because their drivers ran out of hours.
sentences.zh: 卡车像搁浅的鲸鱼一样停在最糟糕的地方，因为司机的工时用完了。

sentences.en: You've probably seen those trucks yourself.
sentences.zh: 你可能自己也见过那些卡车。

sentences.en: Well, that's because in December 2017, a new mandate came into effect requiring virtually all trucks on the road to run an electronic log.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那是因为在2017年12月，一项新的强制令生效，要求路上几乎所有的卡车都必须使用电子日志。

sentences.en: And to me, it's a slap in the face.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这简直是打脸。

sentences.en: Driving a truck at 18 years old, I'm now 33, closing in on 2 million miles, I have a clean driving record.
sentences.zh: 我18岁开始开车，现在33岁，快跑了200万英里，我的驾驶记录一直很干净。

sentences.en: To me, that all comes down to the way I was taught.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这一切都归结于我受到的教育方式。

sentences.en: That comes down to the responsibility of knowing you're operating an 80,000-pound machine.
sentences.zh: 这归结于你知道自己在操作一台8万磅重的机器所应承担的责任。

sentences.en: The fact that they're going to tell me that I need this thing in my truck to keep me safe on the road doesn't sit well with me at all.
sentences.zh: 他们竟然告诉我，我需要在卡车里装这个东西来保证我的行车安全，这让我非常不舒服。

sentences.en: No, I hear you loud and clear.
sentences.zh: 不，我完全明白你的意思。

sentences.en: We do these Ohio-Texas-Florida triangles a lot.
sentences.zh: 我们经常跑俄亥俄州-德克萨斯州-佛罗里达州这条三角路线。
丹妮丝（Denise）的继母快不行了。

sentences.en: She's in a Louisiana nursing home.
sentences.zh: 她在路易斯安那州的一家疗养院。

sentences.en: And we want to see her.
She's days away from dying, literally days away from dying.
sentences.zh: 她离去世只有几天了，真的是几天了。

sentences.en: And essentially, we've got to say our goodbyes to her in about 45 minutes because our 14-hour clock is ticking.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我们只有大约45分钟的时间和她告别，因为我们的14小时计时器在滴答作响。

sentences.en: And I just have this moment of complete clarity that something's got to give.
sentences.zh: 那一刻我突然完全清醒地意识到，必须得做出改变了。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of people that will say, hey, that's not true.
sentences.zh: 很多人会说，嘿，那不是真的。

sentences.en: They don't force you to drive tired.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有强迫你疲劳驾驶。

sentences.en: They don't force you to not take a shower, yada, yada, yada.
sentences.zh: 他们没有强迫你不去洗澡，等等等等。

sentences.en: The thing doesn't reach up and grab me and tell me I need to keep trucking.
sentences.zh: 这东西不会伸手抓住我，告诉我必须继续开车。

sentences.en: But the sad reality is, is they kind of do.
sentences.zh: 但可悲的现实是，它们确实在某种程度上起到了这种作用。

sentences.en: Now, I should say here that Mike does not run an e-log.
sentences.zh: 现在，我应该说明一下，迈克并不使用电子日志。

sentences.en: The reason my truck don't need one is because the cutoff date is 2000 and newer need them and 99 and older do not.
sentences.zh: 我的卡车不需要它的原因是截止日期是2000年及以后的车需要安装，而99年及以前的则不需要。

sentences.en: So his 99 Peterbilt is just too old to connect to a computer.
sentences.zh: 所以他那辆99年的彼得比尔特太老了，连不上电脑。

sentences.en: But Mike has done more than just avoid the new regulation.
sentences.zh: 但迈克所做的不仅仅是避开这项新规定。

sentences.en: So we started the United States Transportation Alliance.
sentences.zh: 所以我们成立了美国运输联盟（United States Transportation Alliance）。

sentences.en: And the unique thing about us is that all of us are drivers that met through doing protest type stuff, you know, for the industry.
sentences.zh: 我们独特的地方在于，我们所有人都是通过参与行业抗议活动而结识的司机。

sentences.en: And nobody out here that is making these rules or regulations or pushing for rules or regulations have ever sat behind the wheel for any amount of time.
sentences.zh: 而且外面那些制定这些规则或法规，或者推动这些规则或法规的人，从来没有坐过驾驶座哪怕一分钟。

sentences.en: And definitely not any time recently.
So, you know, when we go to D.C.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，当我们去华盛顿特区时，

sentences.en: and we go every month right now, you know, we park our trucks.
sentences.zh: 我们现在每个月都去，我们把卡车停在那里。

sentences.en: We meet with congressmen and senators and FMCSA.
sentences.zh: 我们与国会议员、参议员和联邦汽车运输安全管理局（FMCSA）会面。

sentences.en: That's the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration.
sentences.zh: 那就是联邦汽车运输安全管理局。
我们和卡车司机工会（Teamsters）也见过面。

sentences.en: So it's been it's been a pretty good thing.
sentences.zh: 所以这已经是一件相当不错的事情了。

sentences.en: And we were fortunate enough to help with the hours of service that are supposed to be changed.
sentences.zh: 我们很幸运能够协助推动那些即将被修改的服务时间规定。

sentences.en: I'm actually expecting an announcement here at Matt's for that.
sentences.zh: 我其实正期待着马特（Matt's）那里能发布相关公告。

sentences.en: In fact, the keynote speaker for the weekend is none other than Elaine Chao, the United States Secretary of Transportation.
sentences.zh: 事实上，周末的主旨演讲嘉宾正是美国交通部长赵小兰（Elaine Chao）。

sentences.en: So we're hoping that it has to do something with that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们希望这与此有关。

sentences.en: I realize things change with the times and technology goes and this and that and the other thing.
sentences.zh: 我明白时代在变，科技在进步，诸如此类的事情也在发生。
但卡车运输终究还是卡车运输。

sentences.en: And I chose, me personally, I chose to drive a truck because I grew up around trucks and I love trucks.
sentences.zh: 我个人选择开卡车，是因为我从小就在卡车堆里长大，我热爱卡车。

sentences.en: And for me, you know, it sounds kind of corny.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，你知道，这听起来可能有点老套。

sentences.en: But the other week I was invited to a concert by someone that we know backstage and stuff.
sentences.zh: 但前几周，我的一位熟人邀请我去后台看一场演唱会之类的活动。

sentences.en: And afterwards we were hanging out and like watching this guy up on stage.
sentences.zh: 结束后，我们聚在一起，看着台上那个人。

sentences.en: You could tell he was just in his zone.
sentences.zh: 你能看出来他完全沉浸在自己的状态里。

sentences.en: the best way I could describe watching you on stage is like me riding across the California or Arizona desert with a truck pressed out and the moon lit and the chicken lights on and just pipes singing and,
sentences.zh: 我能形容看你表演的最佳方式，就像我开着一辆精心改装的卡车，穿过加州或亚利桑那州的沙漠，月光洒在路上，车上的装饰灯亮着，排气管轰鸣着，
你知道，那种巡航的感觉。

sentences.en: And some people are like, what?
You're just driving a truck down the road.
sentences.zh: 你不就是开着卡车在路上跑吗？

sentences.en: And I'm like, yeah, but to me, it's more than just driving a truck down the road.
sentences.zh: 我会说，是的，但对我来说，这不仅仅是开车上路。

sentences.en: You know, it's the freedom of it.
And that's kind of being taken away is what the bad part is.
sentences.zh: 而糟糕的是，这种自由正在被剥夺。

sentences.en: You know, if we don't do anything to help fight this stuff, guys like me are going to be gone.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果我们不采取行动来抗争，像我这样的人终将消失。

sentences.en: After the break, we'll hear that big announcement from Elaine Chow.
sentences.zh: 休息过后，我们将听到赵小兰带来的重大公告。

sentences.en: But first, we venture out onto the parking lot at Matt's.
sentences.zh: 但首先，我们要去马特（Matt's）的停车场看看。

sentences.en: We'll hear why this e-log thing is such a big deal.
sentences.zh: 我们将了解为什么这个电子日志（e-log）问题如此重要。

sentences.en: And I'll tell you what gave for me.
sentences.zh: 我也会告诉你这对我的影响。

sentences.en: And how ELDs led, at least indirectly, to the making of this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 以及电子记录设备（ELDs）是如何间接促成了这档播客的诞生。

sentences.en: You're listening to Over the Road on 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 你正在收听的是《99%隐形》（99% Invisible）旗下的《公路之上》（Over the Road）。

sentences.en: Here again is Over the Road.
I'm the senior editor with Overdrive Magazine, which is helping to produce this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我是《超速》（Overdrive）杂志的高级编辑，该杂志正在协助制作这档播客。

sentences.en: For those of you who are new to this trucking world, Overdrive is basically a trade publication for independent truckers,
sentences.zh: 对于那些刚接触卡车运输世界的人来说，《超速》基本上是一本面向独立卡车司机的行业刊物，

sentences.en: ones who own the rigs they haul with.
sentences.zh: 也就是那些拥有自己运输车辆的司机。

sentences.en: For many years, we've called ourselves the voice of the American trucker.
sentences.zh: 多年来，我们一直自称为美国卡车司机的代言人。

sentences.en: And so part of what we wanted to do with this podcast was to actually build a little bridge
sentences.zh: 所以我们制作这档播客的部分初衷，就是想架起一座小桥，

sentences.en: between the highway haulers who read Overdrive and, well, the uninitiated among you.
sentences.zh: 连接阅读《超速》的公路运输者和你们这些门外汉。

sentences.en: So I'm going to be hosting a special series of mini-episodes
sentences.zh: 因此，我将主持一系列特别的迷你剧集，

sentences.en: where I'll take questions from those of you outside the business
sentences.zh: 我会收集你们这些圈外人的问题，

sentences.en: and put them directly to our trucking listeners.
sentences.zh: 并直接向我们的卡车司机听众提问。

sentences.en: We're calling it the Channel 1-9 Special,
sentences.zh: 我们将其命名为“1-9频道特别节目”（Channel 1-9 Special），

sentences.en: after the CB radio channel used for trucker-to-trucker information sharing.
sentences.zh: 取名自卡车司机之间用于信息共享的CB无线电频道。

sentences.en: The first Channel 1-9 episode will show up in your feed next week,
sentences.zh: 第一期“1-9频道”节目将于下周出现在你的订阅源中，

sentences.en: but I'm dropping in now to ask a quick favor.
sentences.zh: 但我现在插播进来，是想请大家帮个小忙。

sentences.en: If you've got questions about trucking, seriously,
sentences.zh: 如果你对卡车运输有疑问，认真的说，

sentences.en: about anything at all having to do with it,
sentences.zh: 关于任何与之相关的事情，

sentences.en: no question is too simple or too strange,
sentences.zh: 没有太简单或太奇怪的问题，
请拨打 765-245-4844 给我们打电话，

sentences.en: Be sure to state your name and location with your question.
sentences.zh: 提问时请务必说明你的姓名和所在地。

sentences.en: Okay, so back to the Mid-America Trucking Show.
sentences.zh: 好了，回到全美卡车展（Mid-America Trucking Show）。

sentences.en: I want to pick things up the next morning,
sentences.zh: 我想从第二天早上开始讲起，

sentences.en: outside in the parking lot where drivers are busy polishing their trucks.
sentences.zh: 在停车场外面，司机们正忙着擦亮他们的卡车。

sentences.en: There are actually two parking lots of trucks at Mance,
sentences.zh: 在马特（Mance）实际上有两个卡车停车场，
每个都有自己独特的氛围。

sentences.en: There's the show lot and the Papa John's lot.
sentences.zh: 一个是展示区，一个是棒约翰（Papa John's）区。

sentences.en: We'll explain why it's called that in a minute.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后会解释为什么叫这个名字。

sentences.en: But the show lot is home to the Paul K.
sentences.zh: 但展示区是保罗·K·杨（Paul K. Young）卡车选美大赛的举办地。
我们的一天就是从那里开始的。

sentences.en: And that's where we start our day.

sentences.zh: 我正在处理“过度行为”（Excessive Behavior）一号车。

sentences.en: I'm working on excessive behavior, number one.

sentences.zh: 我的卡车名字叫“演出时间”（Showtime）。

sentences.en: The name of my truck is Showtime.
sentences.zh: 你这儿有涡轮增压压力表。

sentences.en: You got your boost pressure down here for your turbo.
sentences.zh: 不，你想看看我的剪贴簿吗？
